title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Speedrunners Have Already Found New Ways to Break the Remake
take: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time's Switch 2 remake just dropped, and guess what? Speedrunners are already having a field day! Within hours, they've found ways to send Link soaring like a rocket and skip entire sections of Hyrule. Forget Nintendo's new sprint feature – players are still proving that rolling or clever item-swapping might be the ultimate way to beat Ganondorf in record time. It's a hilarious testament to the Zelda community's creativity, showing that no matter how classic a game, there's always a new way to break it!

title: BioWare May Be Dead, But a Modder Has Rebuilt Mass Effect 3's Multiplayer Into the Legendary Edition
take: Good news, Commander! While BioWare might be offline, the spirit of Mass Effect 3's amazing multiplayer is alive and well, thanks to some seriously dedicated modders. The ME3Tweaks team, known for their previous Legendary Edition magic, has successfully ported the full multiplayer experience to the remastered trilogy, complete with all those sweet graphical upgrades. Get ready to squad up and take on waves of enemies again for free on N7 Day – just make sure you own the Legendary Edition already! This is exactly why we love the PC gaming community; they truly keep our favorite games kicking.

title: Xbox Series X | X25 Special Edition Console – Invite Requests Are Up at Amazon
take: Remember the mad dash for the super cool translucent green Xbox Series X X25 Special Edition back in August? Most of us were left in the dust! Well, Amazon is giving us another shot at snagging one of these super limited 25th-anniversary consoles, and this time it’s all about the invite. You can request a chance to buy this gorgeous console, featuring that glowing green X logo and a matching controller. With only 25,000 numbered consoles hitting the market, a digital copy of Halo: Campaign Evolved, and that eye-catching translucent green design, it’s worth a shot at the $909.23 price tag to celebrate Xbox’s big 25!

title: The SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Wireless Gaming Headset With Infinite Battery Life Drops to a New Low
take: Talk about a sweet deal! The SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Wireless headset, a true gaming legend, just hit its lowest price ever at $183.99 for PS5, PS4, and PC players. What makes this a must-grab isn't just the amazing sound or comfy design, but that incredible hot-swappable battery system, giving you infinite playtime and zero downtime – perfect for those epic gaming sessions. Seriously, with a 10/10 "Masterpiece" rating and a price nearly $200 less than its successor, this is the ultimate upgrade for any serious gamer.

title: God of War Laufey Delayed to May 2027
take: Looks like we're waiting just a little longer for God of War Laufey, with Sony Santa Monica pushing the release to May 20, 2027! The studio says they need more time to meet those sky-high fan expectations, especially with Kratos taking a backseat this time around. This delay might also give the game some breathing room away from the insanely crowded early 2027 release window, which honestly sounds like a win for everyone. We can't wait to see if a State of Play or The Game Awards will spill more details on this huge expansion of the GoW universe!

title: Maxroll’s World of Warcraft: Forever Guides
take: Get ready to dive headfirst into World of Warcraft: Forever on November 4th, because Maxroll is dropping a whole new arsenal of guides to get you totally prepped! As IGN’s Game Help Alliance partner for RPGs, Maxroll is bringing their A-game with class guides, tier lists, and even a build planner to help you craft the perfect character before you even step foot in Azeroth. Whether you're a seasoned veteran or a fresh-faced adventurer, these tools will be a game-changer for understanding your class, optimizing your talents, and absolutely crushing the competition from day one. Plus, with more endgame guides and a full database on the way, your WoW: Forever journey is about to get a whole lot smoother!

title: Gearbox Calls on Fans to Help Shape the Next Borderlands, Teases 'Exciting Overall Direction' For the Future of the Franchise
take: Gearbox is turning to YOU, Vault Hunters, to help shape the future of Borderlands! While more Borderlands 4 content is on the way next year (get ready for those weekly refreshes!), the big news is that Gearbox is actively listening to community feedback for the *next* game in the franchise. Forget waiting for announcements – this is your chance to tell them what characters you want back and what stories deserve a payoff, especially after Borderlands 4's somewhat rocky reception and performance woes. Head over to their social media and Devcast; they're genuinely tuning in to what fans have to say!

title: UK Deals: AliExpress Has a Ton of Early Black Friday Deals for Gamers
take: UK gamers, listen up! AliExpress is hitting us with some awesome early Black Friday deals, and you absolutely need to check them out. Building a mini PC for all your indie game needs? There are incredible savings on GMKtec mini PCs, like the K12 for just £278.73 after a massive discount. And for all you on-the-go adventurers, grab an Anker Prime Power Bank for charging your Steam Deck or Switch 2, now only £98.24 before extra voucher codes. Seriously, these deals are wild, so don't miss out on upgrading your gaming setup!

title: Nintendo Reveals Surprise Pikmin Day Direct
take: Nintendo just dropped a surprise Pikmin Day Direct, declaring November 1st the official day of those adorable plant-like pals! While we didn't get Pikmin 5 (sob!), it was a fun nine minutes of updates, including a free demo for Pikmin 4 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy hitting November 2nd. Get ready to use your Switch 2's mic to command Oatchi and tackle new challenges in Dandori Academy, plus look out for Secret Caves coming to Pikmin Bloom this winter! Who knew "11.1" could be so significant?

title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 Rating Potentially Leaks Port for Original 2009 FPS
take: Get ready to drop into a classic! It looks like Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 (2009) might be making a comeback, with an R 18+ rating from the Australian Classification Board suggesting a port is on the horizon. While the Black Ops ports earlier this year faced some "low effort" criticism and high prices, they still sold like hotcakes. If Activision and Microsoft bring back the iconic Modern Warfare 2, let's hope for some actual upgrades and maybe a friendlier price tag this time around. Keep those eyes peeled for an official announcement, because we're ready to relive those legendary multiplayer battles!

title: Save $200 Off the 27" Samsung Odyssey OLED G6 240Hz Gaming Monitor Ahead of Black Friday
take: Whoa, gamers, listen up! If you’ve been dreaming of seeing your favorite titles pop on an incredible screen, this is your moment. The 27” Samsung Odyssey OLED G6, a QHD 240Hz monitor, just hit an all-time low price at $399.99! This isn't just any monitor; we're talking QD-OLED tech for brighter colors and true blacks, plus a lightning-fast 240Hz refresh rate perfect for those reflex-heavy shooters and fast-paced action games. Just imagine Fortnite or Valorant looking absolutely stunning with zero ghosting. Pair it with a beefy graphics card, and you're set for gaming bliss with a sweet 3-year burn-in warranty to boot!

title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Patch Makes It Impossible to Get a Nuke in Free-for-All
take: Talk about a nuclear fallout! Modern Warfare 4 players are fuming after a new patch made it literally impossible to earn that coveted tactical nuke Killstreak in Free-for-All. Infinity Ward dropped the FFA win requirement to 25 kills, but you still need 30 consecutive kills for a nuke, leaving folks who wanted to legitimately earn the Ground Zero Calling Card out in the cold. It seems like a heavy-handed fix for account boosting, but completely blocking a challenge feels pretty rough. Hopefully, Infinity Ward cooks up a better solution so players can blast off those nukes again!

title: Blue N.O.V.A. Introduces its Own (Literal) Halo to the PvE Shooter Genre | IGN Preview
take: Blue N.O.V.A. is blasting onto the scene in 2027 with a unique "Halo" system that sounds like a blast for casual co-op shooter fans! This upcoming PvE game is all about teamwork, with a special ring forming around the highest-performing player, granting sweet bonuses like unlimited ammo to everyone inside. While the demo was super early and focused on the gameplay, publisher GungHo is *seriously* invested in a future cast of V-Tubers and iconic characters. It's a bold move for a game so far out, but that ring mechanic sounds like a genuinely brilliant way to keep us working together and having fun!

title: Ghost of Yotei Developer Sucker Punch Hit With Layoffs
take: Oh no, even critically acclaimed studios aren't safe from industry shake-ups! Sucker Punch, the brilliant minds behind the awesome Ghost of Yotei, just laid off 26 employees. This comes hot on the heels of their game's Complete Edition release, making us wonder about the "challenges in the market" and "team needs for their next project" they cited. With Ghost of Yotei selling millions, it’s a stark reminder that even success doesn't guarantee smooth sailing. Here's hoping whatever Sucker Punch is cooking up next brings us more of that sweet, sweet gaming magic!

title: The Best Deals Today: Persona 3 Reload, Pikmin 4, The Adventures of Elliot, and More
take: Calling all RPG fanatics and Nintendo Switch 2 owners! This weekend is your golden ticket to some serious gaming discounts. Persona 3 Reload, that massive JRPG you can lose 100 hours in, is a steal at $24.99 on Amazon for the Switch 2. Good news for those who held off: Atlus has patched up those initial frame rate hiccups and even added 60 FPS support in docked mode. So if you're ready for an epic journey, now's the time to dive in without a worry!

title: Dead by Daylight to Remove Chucky Content Just Months After Losing Michael Myers
take: Oh no, not again! Dead by Daylight is saying goodbye to Chucky, with the pint-sized terror leaving the game and digital stores on November 24th. This news hits hard, especially after Michael Myers vanished just this past January, making it feel like Behaviour Interactive is losing iconic horror licenses faster than we can escape a chase. If you've been eyeing that Good Guy Killer or his creepy cosmetics, now's your absolute last chance to snag them during the 50% off "Last Chance" sale, because once they're gone, they're gone for new players forever.

title: Save $50 Off a 512GB Nintendo Switch 2 Memory Card That We've Personally Tested and Vetted
take: Your shiny new Nintendo Switch 2 might boast 256GB of storage, but let's be real, that's barely enough for a few hefty titles! Seriously, with games like Final Fantasy 14 gobbling up 117GB and Cyberpunk 2077 needing 60GB, you'll be hitting that storage wall faster than you can say "Game Over." Good news though: Amazon's got a sweet deal on the Samsung P9 512GB Micro SDXC Express Card, knocking $50 off! Remember, your old Switch's MicroSD won't cut it, as the Switch 2 demands the zippier Express cards for those lightning-fast 800MB/s transfers. Snag this tested card now and download all the epic adventures your heart desires!

title: Amazon Has a Decent Sale on PS5 Games in the Run Up to Black Friday
take: Amazon's kicking off Black Friday sales early with some sweet PlayStation 5 game deals! You can snag Final Fantasy VII Rebirth for a ridiculous $20, which is a total steal if you're getting ready for the next game. Pragmata, one of our favorite games this year, is also at a new low for everyone, not just Prime members. Plus, new releases like Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy and Mouse: P.I. For Hire are hitting fresh low prices. Keep an eye on Amazon, because these early discounts are a perfect excuse to grab some awesome PS5 titles.

title: Modern Warfare 4's DMZ Players Are Losing Loot to Server Crashes Despite Official Fix from Infinity Ward
take: Uh oh, Modern Warfare 4's new DMZ mode is having some serious server crash headaches, and players are losing all that sweet, sweet newly-earned loot! While Infinity Ward has rolled out a fix and clarified that you'll keep your starting gear and progression, anything you picked up during a crashed match is gonezo. Talk about a buzzkill when you're grinding for those rare finds! It seems some players are still experiencing issues, so let's hope this gets fully sorted before MW4's big launch on Friday, because nothing sours an early access experience like losing your hard-won goodies to a technical glitch!

title: DayZ Badlands Collector's Vinyl Box Set Available Exclusively at IGN Store
take: DayZ fans, get ready to dive even deeper into the Badlands! Bohemia Interactive just launched a killer collector's vinyl box set for the new expansion, packed with some seriously cool loot. For $140, you’re not just getting the DayZ and Badlands soundtracks on sweet 2LP vinyl; there's also an A4 art print, a Morse code poster for new radio gameplay (how awesome is that?!), and three lore-based patches – plus a Steam code for the game and a premium presentation box! This treasure chest of DayZ goodness is exclusive to the IGN Store in North America and Bohemia's own store for EU folks. Just remember, it won't ship until December 2026, so you've got a bit of a wait, but clearly, this is one to pre-order before it vanishes!

title: PlayStation Shadowdrops Saros Zenith Update With Boss Rush, New Game+ and Fancy Golden Crown Powerups
take: Housemarque just dropped a surprise update for Saros, and it’s a golden ticket to more intense fun! The Zenith update brings a Boss Rush mode for leaderboard glory and New Game+ that throws mysterious Eclipse Layers and even deadlier enemies your way. But the coolest part? Your character, Arjun, gets a flashy golden crown and glowing armor the more challenges you activate – talk about flexing! Plus, Housemarque added some awesome accessibility features, like slowing down projectiles and auto-fire, so everyone can jump into the high-octane action. Get ready to crown your run and climb those leaderboards!

title: Battlefield 6 Devs Respond After Players Take Aim at 'Secuty' Typo and Cosmetic With 5 Pistols
take: Battlefield 6 players have been quick to call out some hilarious cosmetic blunders in Season 5! Turns out the "Secuty" typo on an armband, which had fans screaming about AI, is indeed getting a fix next month. But get this – that wild "Midnight Mirage" skin sporting five pistol holsters? That's an *intentional* nod to action movie absurdity, according to the devs! So while one gaffe gets corrected, you'll still be able to live out your multi-pistol fantasies. It’s cool to see Battlefield Studios acknowledge player feedback, even if they’re sticking to their guns (pun intended!) on the over-the-top designs.

title: Apparent Leaked Footage Shows Canceled Assassin's Creed Game Set in Qin Dynasty China
take: Hold up, did we just get a peek at a *canceled* Assassin's Creed game that looked absolutely epic? Leaked footage of "Assassin's Creed Destiny" shows a massive open-world AC set in Qin Dynasty China, complete with a fancy umbrella weapon and player choice for protagonists! While we’re getting the mobile-focused Assassin’s Creed Jade in the same setting, this console/PC version looks like it could have been a true historical playground, focusing on Liu Bang's rise to power with a distinct yin-yang UI. It's a real shame this Ubisoft-Tencent partnership never saw the light of day, especially when big upcoming titles like Hexe are reportedly having their own development woes.

title: Activision Thinks GTA 6 Will Actually Help Modern Warfare 4: 'No Offense to Zelda, but [GTA and COD] Are the 2 Biggest Games of the Year'
take: Forget the "Barbenheimer" of gaming, Activision thinks the launch of GTA 6 this November is actually going to be a massive win for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4! They're banking on the sheer hype around Rockstar's behemoth to bring more players to their consoles, creating a rising tide that lifts all gaming boats. Activision’s chief marketing officer even called COD and GTA the "two biggest games of the year" (sorry, Zelda!). This strategy is all about getting those dusty consoles fired up and getting more eyeballs on the gaming landscape, which sounds like a win for everyone who loves to play.

title: PlayStation Plus Game Catalog October 2026 Lineup Confirmed
take: Your October 2026 PlayStation Plus lineup is looking absolutely stacked, folks! Get ready to dive into some serious narrative gold with Mafia: The Old Country, a prequel that scored a fantastic 8/10 for its writing and world. Plus, don't even get us started on Horizon Forbidden West, a 9/10 first-party masterpiece that's perfect for exploring. And for those Premium subscribers, a dose of classic survival horror awaits with Dino Crisis 2. Seriously, grab your controllers – this month’s additions are a gaming buffet!

title: Over 1 Million Characters Have Been Made in the WoW Forever Beta
take: WoW Forever's beta is absolutely crushing it, with over a million characters already created! That's a huge milestone, especially since most players had to shell out $30 for the Skyborne pack just to get in. Forget those fancy blue elves, it looks like good old Humans and Undead are still the fan favorites for Alliance and Horde respectively. This massive beta turnout, even with a level 30 cap and a full character wipe before launch, is a seriously good sign for Blizzard – even if GTA 6 looms!

title: The Best Controllers for Playing PC Games in 2026
take: Forget searching for your next PC controller, because the future of gaming input is already here! IGN has crowned the Flydigi Vader 5 Pro the champion of 2026, and after weeks of serious testing, we're not surprised. Those clicky mechanical buttons, fantastic battery life, and Hall Effect thumbsticks with adjustable tension are a game-changer, especially for us casual players who want to avoid dreaded stick drift. Just remember, if you're a symmetrical stick fan or need a supersized pad, you might need to keep hunting.

title: Tekken 8 Yujiro Teaser Reveals Baki Rep's In-Game Render Is Just as Uncanny as Fans Expected
take: Tekken 8's latest reveal has Baki fans buzzing with the first look at DLC character Yujiro Hanma! Bandai Namco dropped a teaser at Evo France 2026, and Yujiro's in-game render is exactly the uncanny, muscle-bound menace we all expected. While kangaroo-and-joey duo Roger Jr. steals most of the new trailer's spotlight with gameplay dropping November 11, the "Ogre" himself is still a ways off. Get ready to mark your calendars because a full Yujiro trailer is set to premiere at the Tekken World Tour Finals on January 17, 2027, where we’re definitely hoping for a release date and some crushing gameplay!

title: GTA 6 Leaker Threatens to Release Build With Full Story Mode Played to the End, Ties Lucia's Clothing to Crypto Scheme
take: Well, this is certainly a wild ride for GTA 6! A leaker is threatening to drop a full story mode playthrough if their memecoin hits a whopping $30 million market cap, all while claiming it’s a protest for physical game discs. While the market cap is nowhere near that massive target, the audacity of tying Lucia's outfits to crypto investments is just... something else. Rockstar is definitely having a rough time keeping things under wraps, but let's hope this crypto-fueled drama doesn't spoil too much of the fun before we can actually play the game!

title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Launch Rollout Adds DMZ Early Access
take: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is pulling out all the stops for pre-order players, now offering early access to the revamped DMZ mode alongside the campaign! Infinity Ward is clearly taking a big swing at making DMZ the definitive extraction shooter, promising persistent progression in the new Hajin Exclusion Zone. After the original DMZ was deemed a bit of an "underwhelming prototype," it's exciting to see Activision give it another shot, especially for those of us who love a good open-world combat sandbox. So, if you've pre-ordered, mark your calendars for October 20th – it's time to see if this "fully fleshed-out evolution" lives up to the hype!
